messages:
devon: rolled v1.12.2 to canary (us-east1) and kicked off post-deploy synth checks. small cohort, 5 hosts.

deploy-bot: canary:us-east1 -> 10% traffic, hosts=5, status=UP. synth-check id=schema-smoke-9921 started.

rachel: quick flag 1m in: synth evaluator failing on structured-output tests. failing cases = missing "intent" key in JSON output, e.g. payload is a string not object.

omar: paste sample from synth agent?

rachel: sample (from synthetic runner):
```
INPUT: "Summarize: increment user quota by 10 for plan=pro"
EXPECTED: {"intent":"modify_quota", "params":{"delta":10}}
GOT: "modify_quota: delta=10"
```

rachel: tests spike fail rate ~6% on canary. No 5xxs; responses are 200 but format wrong.

omar: interesting. traces show model produced plain text frequently. Tokenizer diff? New model variant in v1.12.2 merged an updated tokenizer (subword cut change) that changes stop-token behavior for structured generation.

yuki: cross-region checks? any similar in eu or apac?

rachel: eu probes all green. Only us-east1 affected. Region-specific because canary used a newer model artifact uploaded to us-east build group accidentally.

ops-bot: alert created: INF-3567  synth-schema-drift - assigned=omar, sev=medium.

omar: recommend pause rollout, pin region to previous artifact v1.12.1 for routing, and run a targeted regen test with explicit stop-token + prompt-prefix to validate. Also add an interim check on structured-output parser to reject text responses.

yuki: agreed. @deploy-bot pause and pin fallback to v1.12.1 for us-east1.

deploy-bot: actioned: canary rollout paused at 10% by yuki. fallback_pin=release/v1.12.1 applied for region=us-east1. synth-check continues in read-only. audit:yuki@1759001280.

devon: thanks. I'll update release notes and the changelog entry to note tokenizer artifacts. We should also add preflight to CI that runs structured-output smoke for any tokenizer changes.

omar: in meantime I'll re-run synth with old tokenizer and with forced stop-token and confirm pass rate. If pass rate > 99% for 15m, we can unpause to 30% with artifact pin. Otherwise rollback.

rachel: 7m update: re-run with forced stop-token -> pass rate back to baseline ~0.3% fail. Parser rejects freeform strings now. Looks stable.

yuki: plan: hold 15m verification, if stable unpause to 30% with artifact pin + structured-output guard enabled for 1 hour. If regression > 2% for 10m, rollback.

devon: noted. tagging INF-3567 and will close after post-verification.

ops-bot: note: rollback_condition set: structured-fail-rate > 2% over 10m.

devon: thanks team. keeping thread for verification updates.
